aboutMe: I'm a Brazilian developer-designer who believes the gap between design and engineering is artificial. My work spans full-stack development with React, Next.js, and Node.js — and UI/UX design covering research, systems design, prototyping, and motion. I'm fluent in both Figma and a terminal. Currently at Nubank, building product infrastructure used by millions of customers across Latin America.
